title: My Documents
subtitle: Write your paper from scratch with the AI writing editor.
empty: No documents yet — create your first one.
confirmDelete: Delete this document? This cannot be undone.
outlineEmpty: Add headings and they'll show up here.

ai.cycleHint: AI autocomplete mode (click to cycle: auto / manual / off)
ai.hintAuto: Suggests at word/sentence ends · Tab to accept · ⌘/Ctrl+J for one now

citation.panelDesc: Search scholarly works (OpenAlex) by keyword, or select a sentence in your text.
citation.searchPlaceholder: Search by keyword or a sentence…
citation.searchPrompt: Type a query above to search scholarly works, or select a sentence in your text.
citation.noResults: No matching works — try rephrasing or a more specific keyword.
citation.semanticHint: Semantic similarity between your claim and this abstract (used to re-rank, beating raw keyword order)
citation.verifyNeedsClaim: Type the claim to support in the search box first
citation.verifyNoClaim: Couldn't find the sentence this citation sits in
citation.groundFulltext: Sentences in the full text that best support you
citation.groundAbstract: Sentences in the abstract that best support you (no full text)
citation.groundNone: No source text available to match
citation.referencesEmpty: No citations in this document yet.
citation.refreshHint: Re-fetch from OpenAlex to fix dead or outdated links

rewrite.panelDesc: Pick a rewrite style or type a custom instruction; AI rewrites your highlighted text.
rewrite.customPlaceholder: Type a custom instruction, e.g. “make it more concise”
rewrite.prompt: Pick a rewrite style, or type a custom instruction.

outline.panelDesc: Apply the standard IMRaD structure, or type a topic and let AI generate a tailored heading tree.
outline.imradDesc: Intro · Literature · Methods · Results · Discussion · Conclusion
outline.topicPlaceholder: Enter a topic, e.g. “the effect of flow on online learning motivation”
outline.prompt: Enter a topic and generate to preview the heading tree here.

slash.imageHint: Upload an image with a caption

tableList.title: List of Tables
tableList.empty: No tables in the document yet.

figureList.title: List of Figures
figureList.empty: No figures in the document yet.

defect.panelDesc: Checks structural defects with the 13 REL rules (claims without evidence, methods without motivation, misaligned conclusions…). Click “Locate” to jump to the sentence.
defect.checking: Checking… (runs several LLM calls, please wait)
defect.needsText: The document has no content to check yet

export.panelDesc: Pick a format to download. Citations are written in the current “{style}” style with a reference list.
export.docxDesc: Open and edit in Word / Google Docs
export.latexDesc: ctex CJK support; bundled as .zip (with images) when figures exist
